description: List the Planner plans the session's signed-in user has access to — no group ID or guessing needed. On app-only sessions there is no signed-in user: pass user_id (from planner_find_user) to list the plans shared with that user.

response_format.description: Output format: human-readable markdown (default) or structured JSON

user_id.description: List plans shared with this user ID instead (required on app-only sessions)

name: planner_list_my_plans
title: List Accessible Plans
